news.headline: uniQure to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on July 29
news.summary: uniQure confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results before market open on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, with a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET covering results and a pipeline/regulatory update. It will be the first quarterly update since the FDA's mid-June agreement on the AMT-130 accelerated-approval pathway.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Maintains uniQure at Hold, $46 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs reiterated its Neutral/Hold rating on uniQure with a $46 price target, keeping a cautious stance even after the stock's sharp June rally on FDA news.

news.headline: Aberdeen Group plc (abrdn) trims uniQure stake to 4.52% as JPMorgan discloses new 7.0% passive position
news.summary: Aberdeen Group/abrdn filed a Schedule 13G/A on July 20 disclosing a reduced passive stake of about 2.85 million uniQure shares (4.52%) as of June 30, down from roughly 8.5% earlier in 2026. Days earlier, on July 16, JPMorgan Chase filed a 13G showing a new 7.0% passive stake of about 4.87 million shares, part of a wave of large institutional filings following the AMT-130 rally.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright raises uniQure price target to $80 following AMT-130 regulatory clarity
news.summary: In the wake of the FDA's mid-June agreement allowing AMT-130's ~3-year Phase I/II data to support an accelerated-approval BLA, H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target to $80 (from $50) and Mizuho raised its target to $68 (from $35) while reiterating bullish ratings, part of a broader wave of sell-side upgrades.

news.headline: uniQure closes upsized $259 million public offering
news.summary: uniQure closed its underwritten offering of 5,686,813 ordinary shares at $45.50 per share, upsized from an initially announced $150 million raise and including underwriters' full option exercise, for gross proceeds of approximately $259 million. Proceeds are earmarked to fund AMT-130 commercialization readiness, the FDA-required confirmatory study, and the broader pipeline.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Preliminary Data on the First Cohort in the Phase I/IIa Clinical Trial of AMT-260 in Refractory Mesial Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
news.summary: uniQure reported initial six-month data from the first, low-dose cohort (n=6) of its Phase I/IIa AMT-260 gene therapy trial for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, with three of six patients showing 79%-100% reductions in disabling seizures as of a May 29, 2026 data cutoff. The therapy was generally well tolerated with no serious treatment- or procedure-related adverse events, and enrollment continues in a second, higher-dose cohort expected to complete around mid-2026.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Plan for BLA Submission for AMT-130 in Huntington's Disease
news.summary: uniQure announced that at a Type B meeting the FDA agreed three-year Phase I/II data for AMT-130 can serve as the primary efficacy basis for an accelerated-approval Biologics License Application in Huntington's disease, reversing the agency's more cautious November 2025 stance on using external-control comparators. The company said it plans to submit the BLA in Q3 2026 while finalizing the design of a required post-approval confirmatory study with the FDA; shares surged sharply on the news.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: uniQure will report second-quarter 2026 financial results before market open on July 29, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET covering financials and a pipeline/regulatory update.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission (US)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, based on ~3-year Phase I/II data accepted by the FDA as the primary efficacy basis.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA MAA filing for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Following a successful pre-submission meeting, uniQure plans to file a Marketing Authorization Application with the UK MHRA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease.

catalysts.label: FDA alignment on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: Before the BLA submission, uniQure still needs to finalize the design of the required post-approval confirmatory study with the FDA, including whether it uses a concurrent standard-of-care control arm instead of a sham-surgery placebo.

catalysts.label: 4-year AMT-130 data analysis
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete a 4-year analysis of the Phase I/II AMT-130 data, following FDA feedback on the statistical analysis plan discussed at the Type B meeting.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose cohort enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second, higher-dose (3x10^12 gc/mL) cohort of six patients in the Phase I/IIa AMT-260 trial for refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, following preliminary low-dose cohort data reported in June 2026 showing 79%-100% seizure reductions in 3 of 6 patients.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 updated data (both cohorts)
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to present updated efficacy/safety results from both the low- and higher-dose AMT-260 cohorts in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA accelerated approval decision for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is submitted in Q3 2026 and granted priority review, a potential FDA approval decision could arrive around mid-2027; timing not yet company-confirmed.

catalysts.label: Additional international regulatory updates
catalysts.detail: uniQure is pursuing further regulatory pathways for AMT-130 in additional international markets beyond the US and UK, with updates expected in the second half of 2026.

pulse: uniQure shares surged after the FDA agreed on June 17, 2026 that three-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval BLA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease, reversing a more cautious November 2025 stance; the company closed a since-completed $259 million upsized offering to fund the confirmatory study and launch readiness, and BLA filing is targeted for Q3 2026. Encouraging but early AMT-260 gene-therapy data in refractory epilepsy (79%-100% seizure reductions in 3 of 6 low-dose patients) added to pipeline optimism, though the stock has cooled from its post-FDA-news spike into the $40-$46 range, with Goldman Sachs holding a cautious Neutral/Hold rating even as large institutions (JPMorgan, abrdn) reshuffle passive stakes. Attention now turns to Q2 2026 earnings on July 29 for cash-runway and regulatory updates, with the actual BLA submission and eventual FDA review timeline standing as the next major catalysts.
